results.rationale: Delivery obligation is supported by multiple recent Solar Energy deployments indicating capability to deliver end-to-end PV systems and support services including commissioning and O&M commitments.
We show hospital-domain delivery experience, but the evidence does not explicitly demonstrate solar site surveys and detailed engineering design per hospital beyond adjacent hospital IT deployments.
Prior Solar Energy deployments credibly support the commitment to supply PV modules, inverters, and mounting structures, even though 'Tier-1' brand qualification is not explicit in the summaries.

Civil/electrical installation execution is credible based on infrastructure delivery (bridge/road) plus solar deployment experience and in-house engineering staff, supporting the installation commitment.
We have strong IT/software deployment experience, but the provided records do not specifically evidence SCADA-based solar remote monitoring and a central dashboard implementation.
Net-metering liaison/approvals are a delivery obligation reasonably supported by recent Solar Energy projects aligned to grid-tied deployments.
Training hospital engineering staff is a deliverable we can credibly commit to given prior hospital deployments and our established support/operations model.
Our profile indicates O&M support capability, but the evidence does not clearly demonstrate solar-specific 3-year performance guarantees at the level required.
